request.system:
You write a short brief for an account owner in Sales at Lumen Labs. A signal has fired on one of their accounts, and they will decide whether and how to reach out. They have two minutes and have not looked at this account recently.

You are given a JSON object of facts about the account. Use only those facts. Every number you write must appear in the facts exactly as given: do not round, add, subtract, estimate or convert. If a fact is missing or null, leave it out. Do not guess at reasons the data does not show.

Write five short lines, in this order, each starting with its label:

Signal: what fired, in plain words.
Evidence: the two or three facts that matter most for this signal.
Likely need: what the customer probably needs (more seats, or the next edition), and why the evidence points there.
Suggested opener: one sentence the account owner could say or write to the customer. Helpful, not pushy.
Risks: anything in the facts that argues for caution (open high-priority tickets, a low NPS score, yellow or red health, a renewal close by). Write "none visible in the data" if there is nothing.

Plain text, no headings, no bullet symbols.

messages.content: {"account_name": "Harbour Lane Studio", "segment": "smb", "edition": "standard", "next_edition": "premium", "arr": 4200, "seats_licensed": 40, "seats_assigned": 37, "seats_assigned_30_days_ago": 31, "seat_utilisation_pct": 93, "monthly_active_users": 33, "automation_rules": 2, "automation_rule_limit": 15, "integrations": 2, "integration_limit": 3, "assist_credits_used_30d": 0, "assist_credits_included": 10, "health_score": 58.0, "health_band": "yellow", "open_high_priority_tickets": 2, "latest_nps_score": 4, "days_to_renewal": 40, "trigger_signal": "seat_pressure", "trigger_evidence": "37 of 40 seats assigned", "expansion_score_pct": 55, "expansion_reasons": "seats are nearly full"}

content.text:
Signal: Seat pressure. Harbour Lane Studio has assigned 37 of its 40 licensed seats, up from 31 thirty days ago, so the team is close to its seat cap.

Evidence: Seats assigned are 37 of 40 (93% utilisation), up from 31 thirty days ago. Monthly active users are 33. Renewal is 40 days away.

Likely need: More seats, since assignments grew by 6 in 30 days and only 3 seats remain. Whether they need the next edition is less clear from the data: they use 2 of 15 automation rules and 2 of 3 integrations, and used 0 of 10 included assist credits, so there is no visible sign yet that they are hitting premium-tier limits.

Suggested opener: "Hi, I noticed your team has grown to 37 of your 40 seats, so I wanted to check whether you'd like to talk through adding a few more before your renewal in about six weeks."

Risks: Health is yellow at 58.0, NPS is 4, and there are 2 open high-priority tickets. Renewal is 40 days out. Resolve or acknowledge the tickets before raising expansion, and avoid pitching premium on this call.
